svg.title: Haar integration is already part of each lens. The coefficient wi/h is its actual normalization. For every node its lens integral is zero for the stock density, by the Haar change of variable; the matched course transports this identity to the corresponding finite Wilson equation expression. Expanding by (TS10), its empty subset supplies the main density variation and its nonempty subsets are exactly the secondary terms F in (LCE6). Taylor expansion with the node moments above gives the current divergence and action derivative, with the remainder E. The exact healthy-region identity is therefore M = Z −β X a Da eJab + (divν Yb)(1), (TS12)
